posts.title: Not Traffic from aocr.org: a Forged-Referrer Crawler
posts.description: Matomo has been showing daily visits from www.aocr.org for about a month. The referrer is forged. Fingerprint from this site, how it fits the wider campaign, what not to do, and why I am leaving the traffic alone.

posts.title: Per-User Cloud OAuth on One Host
posts.description: App credentials are site-wide, but refresh tokens are not shared in .env. Each user connects their own Dropbox or Drive account, and CLI maps to one user.

posts.title: WebAuthn and TOTP Without a Framework
posts.description: Passkeys and authenticator apps in plain PHP: relying-party identity, session ceremonies, trusted-device cookies, recovery codes, and an explicit CLI exception.
